narrative.overview:
Koonpinai uses the user-approved Cloud & Sky system across login, the directory, timetables, imports, account setup, policy, approval and administration. The pastel-blue peeking penguin is the sole brand mark, paired with the exact live-text name Koonpinai. Mali headings and Kodchasan UI give English and Thai a soft, readable character; light rules, restrained curves and gentle elevation keep useful controls and data prominent.

The existing shadcn Nova/Radix foundation remains, while the V3 palette, typography and mascot supersede all earlier visual directions. Light mode uses a pale-blue canvas, white surfaces and navy ink; dark/system mode uses derived navy surfaces. Login deliberately keeps the light palette under either OS theme. Missing data remains an honest empty state; development samples and temporary imports never imply a real shared-timetable service.
keyCharacteristics: One approved peeking penguin and the exact Koonpinai name.
Cloud & Sky across every route, with a derived navy dark appearance.
Mali headings and Kodchasan body/UI, loaded once with Thai and Latin coverage.
Compact schedule workspaces, readable mobile rows and useful empty states.
Written status, visible focus, deliberate review and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Single Identity Rule
rules.body: Use the approved peeking penguin and exact Koonpinai wordmark everywhere; never substitute the former K symbol or translate the official name.

rules.name: The Status Has Words Rule
rules.body: Availability always includes a written label; color reinforces rather than replaces its meaning.

rules.name: The Course Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep the six course identities stable across themes and separate from availability meaning. Preserve source-document colors.

rules.name: The Bilingual Reading Rule
rules.body: Use Mali for headings and Kodchasan for UI and timetable data, with Thai coverage and relaxed line heights; retain tabular time without monospace typography.

rules.name: The Honest Empty State Rule
rules.body: No timetable means missing schedule data, never fabricated classes or assumed free time. Confine sample friends to explicit credential-free development mode.

dos: Do use the same Cloud & Sky tokens, Mali/Kodchasan families and approved penguin across all routes.
Do retain exact Koonpinai branding while preserving internal compatibility identifiers.
Do show truthful empty states and keep development samples distinct from configured user data.
Do retain stable course semantics, original PDF colors, written status and visible focus.
Do keep mobile current/next-class content and access controls readable.
Do preserve real SSO, consent, authorization and temporary-import boundaries.
donts: Don't restore the former K mark, competing names or obsolete visual systems.
Don't populate missing timetables with sample classes or interpret missing data as free time.
Don't restore promotional slogans, decorative footers or the removed preview-time control.
Don't introduce heavy glows, glassmorphism, gradients or decorative dashboard filler.
Don't imply that imported schedules publish, persist or enable a shared-timetable backend.
